hero.bio: Computer Science student passionate about software engineering, AI, and scalable systems. Experienced in building backend applications, REST APIs, and AI-powered solutions using Python, FastAPI, C++, and PostgreSQL. Interested in distributed systems, machine learning, and solving real-world problems through efficient and reliable software.

projects.name: SQORA — AI-driven Learning Platform
projects.desc: Built scalable REST APIs using Python and FastAPI with a modular backend architecture for efficient feature integration. Developed a RAG-based retrieval system using Google Gemini API and Qdrant to enable low-latency document retrieval, along with automated data ingestion pipelines for structured learning content.

projects.name: Quadcopter Drone with Onboard Vision
projects.desc:
– Built and tested a manually piloted quadcopter platform with remote-control operation, achieving approximately 20 minutes
of flight time on a 3S battery.
– Integrated an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX for onboard compute and deployed a YOLO-based object detection pipeline on live
camera feeds.
– Measured real-time inference throughput of 10–14 FPS, balancing model performance with onboard compute and power
constraints.
– Designed the project toward vision-guided autonomy and am currently interfacing the Jetson with the flight controller to
send control commands; closed-loop autonomous flight is still in progress

projects.name: Lightweight Version-Control System (C++ CLI)
projects.desc:
A Git-inspired CLI tool for file versioning, commit tracking, and multi-repo management.
– Developed a CLI-based note-taking application with built-in version control, enabling users to commit, diff, and restore
previous note versions seamlessly.
– Implemented a linked-list diff engine in C++ for note versioning, reducing storage by 70% vs full snapshots.
– Integrated AES-256 encryption on all stored notes, achieving zero plaintext exposure on disk and ensuring file-level data
confidentiality at rest.
– Architected a 4-module system for CLI parsing, versioning, encryption, and file management.

projects.name: Grasp-and-Lift EEG Detection
projects.desc: Built an EEG signal processing and 1D CNN-based classification pipeline to detect motor intentions from 32-channel brainwave data during grasp-and-lift tasks. Implemented advanced preprocessing, artifact removal, and feature extraction techniques, achieving multi-label event classification with detailed performance and visualization analysis.

projects.name: CAPR-LB: Context-Aware Proactive Reinforcement Learning Load Balancer
projects.desc: Developing an RL-based load balancing framework for distributed systems using Q-learning and workload-aware routing policies. The project focuses on modeling queueing systems and server environments to optimize traffic distribution, prevent overload, and evaluate routing strategies under varying workload conditions.
